scope: Pinned EconML reuse route for treatment-effect and dynamic-panel targets; conditional proposal decision, no native admission
steps: Resolve py-why/EconML canonical identity and pre-cutoff pin; preserve old403and moving-main provenance.
Inspect selected target, nuisance/fold, inference, panel, weight/missingness and failure source paths with version/license/dependency declarations.
Compare scientific meaning and process boundary with independently specified finite models; retain unsupported regimes.
Record explicit adopt/integrate/port/reference/defer decision, integration_allowed false unless admission criteria actually met; integrate scholarly explanation and matched sponsor.

review.rationale: Separate target identification and uncertainty from implementation speed; inspect original paths before offering adapter admission.

stopping_rule: One bounded pre-cutoff identity acquisition, then selected algorithm/build/test files; retain uninspected families and unresolved native execution as scoped omissions.
limits: Inherited API snapshot points to moving main; do not claim immutable identity yet.
No sibling repository execution or edits.
No live model, bank trial, native package run or complete transitive-license qualification.
